fix: B3 plugin management (Block 16b): per instance, the 34 shipped plugins of eBc-B3 9096624 can be enabled and configured (hash catalog; admin and publist fixed, auth owned by the Block 16 integration, callvote unavailable on the cod4x parser). A shipped module that differs from the catalog needs an approval of the shown SHA-256. Admins (new permission b3.plugins.code) can create custom plugins from a template or as code; CONTROL never runs or imports the code, stores it in <home>/b3/extplugins (0600) and approves its hash on save. Plugin configs live in <home>/b3/plugins (0600), are shown only with config.manage and never logged, audited or hashed. Every B3 start re-checks each enabled plugin (missing, changed, not approved, Python dependency, required plugin, config file) and writes no file when blocked; b3.xml lists admin, the enabled plugins in registry order, then auth. A plugin change asks for a B3 restart (PLUGINS_CHANGED via b3PluginsRevision); nothing restarts automatically. No phone gateway route.
